hero.subtitle: UX Designer & UX Researcher
hero.description: I transform complex problems into intuitive experiences through rigorous research, usability testing, and strategic information architecture. My Systems Analysis background enables me to bridge user needs with technically viable solutions.

about.label: About Me
about.heading: Research, strategy and user experience
about.description: My journey started in systems analysis, where I developed an analytical perspective for understanding complex problems. Today I apply that perspective to UX design, researching behaviors, identifying needs, and designing experiences that bring real value to people. I specialize in user research, information architecture, flow design, and solution validation through usability testing. I continue to grow in UX Design and strengthen my knowledge of user-centered methodologies.
about.card1Text: Interviews, benchmarking, and user analysis to understand real needs.
about.card2Text: Defining opportunities from insights and data to design with purpose.
about.card3Text: Wireframes, user flows, and user-centered information architecture.
about.card4Text: Usability testing and iteration based on real user feedback.

process.label: Process
process.heading: My UX Design Process
process.intro: A structured, user-centered approach that transforms complex problems into intuitive solutions through continuous research and validation.

steps.title: Research
steps.description: User interviews, surveys, competitive analysis, and stakeholder workshops to understand the problem space.

steps.title: Define
steps.description: Synthesize insights into personas, journey maps, and clear problem statements that guide design decisions.

steps.title: Ideate
steps.description: Brainstorming, sketching, and exploring multiple solutions through collaborative design sessions.

steps.title: Prototype
steps.description: Create wireframes and interactive prototypes to visualize and communicate design concepts.

steps.title: Test
steps.description: Usability testing, A/B testing, and iterative refinement based on real user feedback.
